changeinfo.changes: Increases display time on story scenes. Minor corrections to story text and spacing. Date on collectible 7 changed. Trophy image for "Keep Fishin'" trophy has been corrected. Correction to "Notorious" trophy that ensures it unlocks at the correct time. "Surfacing" trophy will now unlock even if skipping final dialogue scene.
"Break It Down Again" trophy unlock corrected. Ensures that scores exactly on the minimum requirement for an A or S rank count towards trophies.

Scarabs hit with paddle shots are now counted towards "Enemy" trophy. Autosaves are now triggered at the start of side modes, to ensure stat tracking. Story scenes and dialogue now require a button press to advance, auto advance has been removed.
If stuck in a wall, the ball/"Bouncer" will now break free.
